en: Black‑and‑white panoramic rural landscape showing flat agricultural fields divided by stone fences and hedges, a long straight country road crossing the scene, and scattered farmhouses and buildings in the distance. In the foreground beside the road stands a small, tall utility or signal hut with overhead wires. Low wooded hills rise in the background. In the lower left corner is printed text reading "Parti av Säve." In the lower right corner there is a triangular logo with a number beneath it.
